No `git clone`, `wget`, or `curl` is used at build time beyond the standard AUR source fetching mechanism. The package also avoids stripping binaries, which is acceptable for a `-bin` package where symbols may be needed.

All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices for a binary distribution. There is no evidence of malicious behavior, data exfiltration, or supply-chain tampering.
